Genuine Apple-signed App Attest vectors. Kept byte-for-byte; do not reformat or edit (any change
breaks the signatures, nonces, or certificate chains these tests rely on).

  expected values show, its nonce was formed from the raw challenge "example_server_challenge"
  rather than its SHA-256. Credential certificate valid 2026-04-20T18:13:12Z to 2026-04-23T18:13:12Z.
